summary: Slightly Mad Studios' Project CARS series is a motorsport simulation line now affected by delisting and licensing expiry.

entries.title: Project CARS
entries.definitive_edition: Owned Game of the Year/final-patch copy, preferably PC for capture

emulation.notes: Native PC/console route; no current normal purchase route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Owned final-patch PC build with DLC and wheel/server state documented

primary.version: Owned Game of the Year/final-patch copy
primary.why: Project CARS was delisted from digital storefronts in 2022 due to expiring car and track licenses, so the current archive route is an owned physical or prior digital copy. PC remains the best capture/settings route when already owned, especially with the Game of the Year content.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned PC copy or physical console copy. Record platform, patch, DLC/GOTY content, controller/wheel and force feedback, graphics settings, assists, car/track, career/event, weather/time-of-day, and online/server availability.

secondary.what_to_play: Use when an owned PC copy is unavailable.
secondary.why: New digital purchase is not normally available.

all_releases.fidelity: Original sim-racing route, now owned-copy dependent.
all_releases.reason: primary: PC is best for capture if already owned; console discs preserve access.
primary: best content scope if preserved.

all_releases.fidelity: No normal new digital purchase route after license expiry.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The game is delisted; completeness depends on owned copy, DLC, and online state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record delisted status, DLC ownership, and wheel/online state.
